result.title: GPT-6 Astra with Ben Davis
result.description: Ben Davis shares his first impressions of GPT-6 Astra after testing it on some of DEF CON's hardest puzzle challenges. He explains how parallel research branches help the model test theories, stay on track, and solve complex problems, including one no one else had solved.

result.title: Introducing GPT-6 Astra for developers
result.description:
Meet GPT-6 Astra, our latest frontier model for tasks where raw intelligence matters. Charlie Guo, Developer Experience Engineer at OpenAI, demonstrates improved Computer Use, stronger creative and knowledge-work outputs, and new asynchronous tool calling and steering in the Responses API.

Read more: https://openai.com/index/gpt-6-astra/

result.title: Use ChatGPT Work to analyze ad performance and refine creative
result.description:
